shots.content_purpose: Add one uniformed person to the left region of the source frame and keep the whole group walking in step, while preserving video_1's scene, performers, framing and locked camera in one continuous shot.
shots.description: The shot begins from the unchanged framing of <Video 1>: a wide locked camera looks across the barren reddish-brown terrain toward the white pyramid habitat labeled "MARS" in the distance, with dark hills along the horizon. The two existing astronauts in cream-white spacesuits with white backpacks walk away from the camera toward the habitat, the left one slightly ahead of the right. In the left region of the frame, one additional person (<Subject 1>) is already present at the first frame, walking away from the camera on open ground to the left of the leftmost existing astronaut, at a similar distance from the camera and clear of both existing figures so that neither is occluded, and remaining continuously in frame. From the first frame onward this added person moves with the same body pose, stride length, arm swing, torso lean and walking rhythm as the neighboring astronaut, so the three sets of footsteps land together and the spacing between the figures stays constant. All three continue walking away from the camera with a steady gait, growing gradually smaller in the wide frame as the distance to the habitat closes, and each suit picks up the same warm low dusk light and casts a long shadow across the terrain. The camera stays locked with no pan, push or zoom, and the shot continues without a cut through the final frame, where the three uniformed figures are still walking away in step toward the habitat. Synchronized with the walk, boots strike loose gravel in one shared rhythm at a moderate distance.
